cat > /tmp/rotaline-shots.4Tm4/shot.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
D=/tmp/rotaline-shots.4Tm4
C="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
shoot() { # size name
  rm -f "$D/$2.png"
  "$C" --headless=new --user-data-dir=$D/prof --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --force-prefers-reduced-motion --window-size=$1 --screenshot="$D/$2.png" "file://$D/test.html" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  local pid=$!
  for i in $(seq 1 30); do [ -f "$D/$2.png" ] && break; sleep 1; done
  sleep 1; kill $pid 2>/dev/null; wait $pid 2>/dev/null
}
shoot "$1" "$2"
EOF

content.text:
I've built the Rotaline landing page as a single `index.html` with all 11 sections and your copy. I checked it in headless Chrome at 1440px and at phone width (390px, rendered inside an iframe because headless Chrome won't go narrower than about 500px).

**Design.** I used the ui-ux-pro-max skill to pick the look. It's a light theme with blue for actions and orange used only to mark "now" in the schedule and swapped shifts. Headings and body use Plus Jakarta Sans, and times and stats use JetBrains Mono, both from Google Fonts. All icons, company marks and the product illustration are inline SVG or HTML/CSS; there are no remote images.

**What's on the page:**
- **Hero illustration:** a week view for a "Payments API" service. It has Primary, Secondary and APAC rows with named shifts, a "now" marker on Monday Oct 26, a weekend override, an "On call now" card and a draft handoff note carrying two open incidents.
- **Pricing toggle:** switching to annual changes Team to $7 and Business to $13, and the billing line updates (e.g. "$84 per user per year"). Screen readers hear the price change.
- **Mobile menu:** below 880px the nav moves into a menu button. It closes with Escape, by clicking outside, or by choosing a link. "Start free trial" stays visible in the header.
- **FAQ:** the five questions open and close, and work without JavaScript.
- **Email form:** it checks the address and shows an error under the field. A valid email gets a short loading state, then a "check your inbox" message. Nothing is actually sent.
- **Accessibility:** there's a skip link, visible keyboard focus, and buttons at least 44px tall. Fade-in animations turn off if the user has asked for reduced motion.

**Issues found and fixed during the check:**
- At phone width the hero column was wider than the screen and pushed the header button and menu off-screen. It now fits.
- The step list showed browser numbers ("1.", "2.") next to my "01/02/03" badges. Removed.
- The floating "Page acknowledged" card covered the schedule header. It now hangs below the panel.
- The "now" marker sat on top of the date. Moved below it.
- "14-day" broke across two lines in the final call to action on mobile. Fixed.

**Copy I added beyond your brief:**
- A "New" badge above the headline: "Handoff notes now carry open incidents forward."
- A footnote under the results saying the figures cover customers' first 90 days, compared with their previous setup.
- A "Save up to 22%" label on the annual toggle.

The screenshots were taken without the web fonts loaded, so the final type will look slightly different, but the layout is the same.
